lines.text: A man planted a vineyard, rented it to tenants, and at harvest sent a servant to collect his share.
The tenants beat the first servant, shamed the second, and wounded the third, and sent all three away.
The owner sent his beloved son, but the tenants wanted the inheritance, threw him out of the vineyard, and killed him.
Jesus said the owner would give the vineyard to others, and the people cheered; whoever falls on the stone will be crushed.

wrong_details.true: said, “May such a thing never happen!”

lines.text: The scribes and chief priests realized the parable was against them and wanted to arrest Jesus, but feared the soldiers.
